title: Personnel of the Celestin band and the Florida tour
summary: Harris names the trumpets, trombones, saxes and rhythm section of Celestin's band, and how he later joined Bartholomew.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Just at that time. Who else was in the band when you played with Celestan?

Well the time I was playing with Celestan, they had a trumpet. We had Andrew Anderson, Dave Bartholomew, and probably Celestan. They had three trumpets. Then we had Bill Matthews on trombone. And when we went up the country we met this big chief Russell Moore. Oh, he played them with them. Yeah, we had two trombones when we was up the state. We had two trombones. Then on saxophone we had me, Willie James, and Claris Hall. That was three saxophones we had.
Willie James, you mean young Willie James?
Then on piano we had Kato, John Porter. What's one of the Kato's? Little Kato or Big Kato? Little Kato. You know Little Kato.
Yeah, Big Kato and Brad. That's his cousin.

Well we had, on the rhythm section we had Leonard Mitchell playing guitar. We had Kimball, not Kimball, John Porter playing bass. And we had Kato playing piano. And that's the Celestans band. Then we had this boy Jewel Lawrence singing. You remember Jewel Lawrence? He used to play the song.
He could sing. He had a song. He used to play the song.
He could clap his hands loud in the back of prison. Yeah, yeah.

Well we went all through the state of Florida. And when I came back, I got a band at the Doudrop. And then a couple of years after that, Dave Bathardy made up his band. So he came over and talked with me and asked me that I wanted to play with him. I joined here. So, started off with that.
